title: FeedMe
tagline: FeedMe is the fun way to keep track of what your frens have been up to onchain
description: FeedMe is, as the name suggests a feed of various wallets' onchain activities. These activities can be any kind of smart contract interaction. The feeds can be curated in various ways, either the default feed (which later should be some kind of "For you"), wallets that you are specifically following, or based on communities. Browse your favorite friend, degen or onchain loss porn artist and if you see something you like, copy their action using our "Copy Action" button!
how_its_made: For FeedMe, we're cleaning up and displaying the onchain data using Nodit, then simply using Curvegrid's MultiBaas to be able to copy any action. These two in combination provides a strong platform for us to build on and further extend. We're especially stoked on how simple Curvegrid makes it to interact with any function on any contract in a dynamic way like this. On top of this, we're using Self Protocol's identity system to get info such as age, gender or nationality which can be used to join different communities for others to follow.
